corrections.reason: See L37 correction for the second half of ጀመሩ.
The glyph on the page clearly has the right-side horizontal stroke of 2nd-order ሩ (ጀመሩ, 'they began to straighten for Him what was crooked', matching the plural Ge'ez verb ወይደሑ).
The printed glyph is 3rd-order ኢ (with the bottom right foot) attached to the verb ኢያንበብክሙኑ ('have you never read at all?'), whereas Stage 1 misread the foot and spacing as ግሙራእ.
The interrogative enclitic in Ge'ez is -ኑ (ይከውንኑ, 'is it lawful?'). Visually on the page, the character is ኑ (with the top bar of ነ and right side-stroke of 2nd order), misread as ሁ.
The printed Ge'ez word is ይከውንኑ ('is it lawful?'), where the 2nd-order ኑ was misread as ሁ.
